extDescription.message: Point, click and hide whatever is in the way. Remembers your choices per site and undoes any change.

grantEach.message: Asks for access on each new site.

supportTitle.message: Optional. Opens buymeacoffee.com in a new tab.

toggleOnTitle.message: Being hidden. Turn it off to see it again without deleting the rule.

toggleOffTitle.message: Off: the element is visible. Turn it on to hide it again.

deleteTitle.message: Delete this rule from the site

temporaryOne.message: 1 element hidden for this visit only.

temporaryMany.message: $1 elements hidden for this visit only.

cardEmptyMeta.message: Move the mouse over the page to see what each block is.

cardEmptyTitle.message: Click an element to mark it. Another click, Hide or Enter hides it.

fragileWarning.message: This selection depends on the page's structure.

shrinkTitle.message: Back to the previous element (down arrow)

markedHint.message: Marked. Confirm with another click on it, with Hide or with Enter. Esc unmarks it.

hiddenSaved.message: Element hidden. Saved for future visits.

hiddenVisit.message: Element hidden until you reload the page.

errAction.message: The action could not be completed.

errSave.message: The change could not be saved.

errPageSilent.message: The page is not responding. Reload it and try again.

errUnsupportedPage.message: Open a regular web page. Chrome does not allow changes to its internal pages or the extension store.

errSiteDenied.message: Access not granted. Turn off “Remember on this site” to use the temporary mode.

errAllDenied.message: Access not granted. You will still be asked on each site.

errAllKept.message: Chrome has not removed the access. You can do it from Details → Site access.

errNotWeb.message: Open an http or https web page.

errNeedPermission.message: Turn on “Remember on this site” and grant access to the site.

errMenuOnly.message: Action only available from the menu.

errMaxRules.message: Maximum of 200 blocks per site. Restore some before continuing.

errRuleGone.message: That rule no longer exists. Open the menu again.

errWholePage.message: Select a component, not the whole page.

errNoSelector.message: This block could not be identified. Try its container.
